additional_observed_artifact_inspection.cross-sheet-undo.xlsx: Budget A1:D1 stay bold. Reference native style/fill/font values are changed instead; its theme/tint font colors become explicit RGB.
additional_observed_artifact_inspection.native-undo.xlsx: Budget A1 gradient becomes no fill; B1 darkGrid becomes a solid black fill. All four Budget font colors change from theme=4/tint=0.25 to rgb=FF7BA1CE. C1 s=0 and D1 omitted s become generated style overrides s=8 and s=9.
additional_observed_artifact_inspection.style_provenance_limit: The serialized overrides were observed directly, but this is not a separate claim that the hasExplicitStyleIndex model flag was corrupted. Those later test assertions were not reached.

authoring.method: Native seed and native fill definitions reused; theme/tint font metadata, explicit/implicit style-zero cells and the second worksheet authored directly as XML. No Quds writer produced the input.

navigation_limit: Only worksheet navigation uses public setActiveSheet; formatting, Undo/Redo and Save use actual ribbon/menu controls.
